entities.name: Query GlmU protein
observations: 461 aa; predicted molecular mass 47.27 kDa and theoretical pI 5.93.
Strong homologs are reviewed bacterial GlmU proteins, with up to 64.5% identity and 95.2% query coverage.
Pfam supports an N-terminal nucleotide-transferase/pyrophosphorylase region and C-terminal Hexapep-containing acetyltransferase region.
Likely bifunctional enzyme catalyzing the final two steps of UDP-N-acetylglucosamine biosynthesis; assignment is homology-based rather than direct biochemical characterization.

source_tools.relevance: Sequence properties, Pfam domains, and homolog annotation

entities.name: GlmU
observations: Bacterial bifunctional enzyme with N-terminal UDP-N-acetylglucosamine diphosphorylase activity and C-terminal glucosamine-1-phosphate N-acetyltransferase activity.
Reviewed homologs are cytoplasmic and commonly form homotrimers.
Reviewed homologs bind one Mg2+ ion per subunit.

entities.name: UDP-GlcNAc
observations: Nucleotide-sugar product of the GlmU-catalyzed pathway.
Required precursor for bacterial peptidoglycan biosynthesis and, in Gram-negative bacteria, lipid A/LPS biosynthesis.

source_tools.relevance: Curated homolog pathway and reaction annotations

entities.name: UDP-GlcNAc biosynthesis
observations: GlmU catalyzes the final two sequential reactions: acetylation of glucosamine-1-phosphate followed by UTP-dependent UDP-GlcNAc formation.
Associated biological processes include peptidoglycan biosynthesis and, where applicable, lipid A biosynthesis.

source_tools.relevance: Curated pathway and GO annotations from homologs

entities.name: Mg2+ cofactor
observations: Reviewed GlmU homologs are annotated to bind one Mg2+ ion per subunit.

entities.name: Bacterial cytoplasm
observations: Reviewed GlmU homologs are annotated to localize to the cytoplasm; the query lacks signal-peptide or transmembrane features expected for secretion or membrane insertion.
